method: Built-in image_gen; new component paint registered to an independently declared native guide. Photo is anatomy reference only.
prompt: Create one isolated LEFT scorpion chela game component on a transparent background, 512x512 square composition. Reference 1 is the independent skeletal/volume guide: keep its wrist near (256,430), palm center (250,280), left movable finger hinge (165,200), curved left finger through (132,115) to (206,47), right fixed finger through (330,190),(340,120) to (280,90). Follow this arrangement and open jaw aperture; do not paint the guide or lines. Reference 2 is the owner's real scorpion photo: use its thick bulbous bean-shaped crushing palm, powerful compact grasp and curved dark fingers. Reference 3 is the existing game paint: match its muted ash sage-grey palette and softly painted volume. Replace the narrow triangular palm with a much wider rounded heavy manus, widest at the middle. One continuous palm with fixed right finger and ONE movable opposing left finger. No forearm, just short wrist. Large quiet smooth surfaces, very low microdetail, no individual plate mosaic, no little seams/no noise. Dark charcoal horn tips, subtle sage-grey highlight on palm, only two broad dark red blood smears on inner grasp surfaces. Strict overhead dorsal orthographic 2D sprite, no perspective tilt, no cast shadow, no ground, no lettering. Keep entire claw within the canvas with margins. Strong rounded mass like the photo, not thin scissors. This is a new UV texture component; preserve transparent cutout edges.
